benefits.title: External audiences better understand the distinctive value of a King’s education
benefits.statement: Applicants, families, employers, partners and other priority audiences encounter a clearer, richer and more persuasive account of what King’s graduates know, can do and contribute.
benefits.beneficiary: Applicants, families, employers, partners and other priority external audiences
benefits.successLooksLike: Graduate premium evidence is routinely used across priority recruitment, market and external-engagement activity, with audiences receiving propositions that are specific, evidence-rich and tailored to what matters to them.

benefits.title: King’s can make better decisions about where its graduate premium is strongest and where it needs strengthening
benefits.statement: King’s gains an aggregated view of the graduate value created across courses and through the wider student experience, allowing institutional and faculty leaders to identify distinctive strengths, recurring gaps and priorities for further enhancement.
benefits.successLooksLike: The combined evidence informs decisions about curriculum, graduate-futures activity, opportunity development and institutional investment, with insight feeding back into programmes and faculties.
